comment: M05 authoring route, seed42, zero bots, m05_no_forwarding_address.json. Ordinary human movement, finite discovery, all21 guards, optional release and actual tram ride. Accurate aim establishes authoring evidence, not fresh-player twelve-minute pacing or all difficulty briefs.

states.name: roof_arrival
states.note: Arrive beside the rooftop tank and Latch, with Low Water homes beyond the roof edge.

states.name: roof_equipment
states.note: Walk from the unchanged entry loadout to discover the normal Rifle, finite Bullets and armor before the crossing alarm.

states.name: roof_crossing_fight
states.note: The post-clear roof exit overlooks the crane and workshop. Required death receipts cover both Notaries and both Clerks; this strip does not establish their flight or attack animation.

states.name: tank_armor_secret
states.note: Claim armor behind the second tank, then walk around its open east side to inspect the registered six-marked service sign.

states.name: crane_walk_descent
states.note: The recognizable gantry is now underfoot. Seven half-metre treads lead to the workshop floor.

states.name: paint_bay_discovery
states.note: The ordinary approach discovers the Shotgun before the service step leads onto the normal0.9m workbench and counted Grenades. Walk along its supported edge for a high lob.

states.name: grenade_lesson_throw
states.note: Launch an ordinary high lob from first person, then follow the confirmed projectile's actual server position. The strip records flight, bounce, fuse and resolved blast hits toward the guarded bay.

states.name: grenade_lesson_clear
states.note: Both named Sweepers remain required, including anyone reached by the actual grenade.

states.name: paint_bay_recovery
states.note: Complete the physical paint-bay arrival and take finite Bullets, health and armor normally. The Shotgun was discovered on the earlier approach.

states.name: workshop_watch
states.note: Two Sweepers and two Clerks hold the open loading pen; later Heavy guards remain absent.

states.name: splice_release
states.note: Actual party approach releases Splice and both captive agents, then steps clear of their lanes instead of walking into the held people. Watch their grounded route toward the open east side; freed is separate from physically aboard.

states.name: service_pit_secret
states.note: Claim the finite reserve Shells and Grenades, then inspect the registered six-marked service-bay sign from the accessible workshop room.

states.name: market_return_secret
states.note: Return to the market through the workshop's open north side. Three medkits and Bullets remain optional, with full-health claims reported honestly.

states.name: trench_supplies
states.note: Finite trench recovery lies on the walking alternative. Ordinary travel fire defends the real mixed encounter.

states.name: trench_watch_clear
states.note: Defeat both Notaries and all three trench Sweepers on the ordinary walking path before boarding.

states.name: tram_docking
states.note: Approach the actual dock. Rescue and dock presence start a bounded boarding pause.

states.name: tram_roof_ride
states.note: A normal jump boards the real roof. Server support carries the pawn with the moving collider; no repositioning or cinematic ride.

states.name: heavy_recovery
states.note: Take normal finite health, Bullets and reserve Grenades before crossing the isolated Heavy threshold. Travel fire remains off while preparing its observed lesson.

states.name: heavy_lesson
states.note: The phase observer starts before the ordinary threshold approach. Hold the supported west aisle below the freight threshold while observing the lone Heavy's actual windup and four-round burst. Ordinary armor and health absorb its committed shots before the Rifle clear; the mixed wave starts on the following deliberate advance.

states.name: freight_watch
states.note: A second Heavy, two Sweepers and two Notaries pressure the freight ramp. Every named guard remains required.

states.name: freight_gate_open
states.note: All six real arrival objectives and the freight guard clear select the precomputed raised gate.

states.name: ship_boarding
states.note: The living ready party enters the ship boarding pad. Captive feet independently determine actual evacuation.

states.name: passenger_review
states.note: A physical F press opens the actual passenger review without sending departure. Inspect aboard, freed and missing before committing.

states.name: departure_cancel
states.note: Physical Escape cancels the review. Mission progress stays intact and no departure action is queued.

states.name: freight_departure
states.note: Fresh local Use confirms departure. The confirmation distinguishes aboard, freed and missing, without inventing a casualty.
